body: Reproduced for 1920x1080, Maximized, Keep Width case, I haven't tested more cases: Godot v4.6.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 31.0.21924.61) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600G with Radeon Graphics (12 threads) - 31.29 GiB memory | -|- https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/da3f75f0-438c-4228-91e3-84d47001c8aa Confirmed #91787 fixes this for me. It should only affect integer scaling cases though. I've just rebased that PR, so artifacts should be available for testing. @HenriAugusto testing that PR welcomed (how-to docs: [testing pull requests](https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/pull_requests/testing.html)). Same setup, v4.7.dev.custom_build [86bcee59f]: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/702f2a09-a887-4f5e-a897-4a8254b73941

I've repeated the tests for every line on the previous sheet where I've seem the bug. I've also repeated some of the tests that we're working (but not all of them, there are too many combinations).

From what I've seem so far, #91787 only fixed the issue for "Maximized". The bug still happens at "Windowed".
It also seems to have fixed the bug on Exclusive Fullscreen for some stranger configurations.

I'm attaching the new test results here: 

[Godot Project Scaling and CollisionPolygon2D bug - Test Results for 91787.pdf](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26253433/Godot.Project.Scaling.and.CollisionPolygon2D.bug.-.Test.Results.for.91787.pdf)

(Also, I've noted the PDF export from the test results inclueded in the MRP was badly cropped. Sorry for that. This one should look better)
